claim: The surface names which absence it is, and never draws a stale frame as current.
found: Capturing the running binary against the installed agent, which predates this feature.
observed: Row 4 of the capture reads: unknown tool "proctor.watch" — the agent answered.
wasWrong: The surface said 'The background agent is not answering' and offered '[a] start the agent', about a process that was already running.

nowSays.headline: The agent is answering but cannot be watched.
nowSays.detail: It is an older build than this supervision surface.

staleness: SupervisionFrame.staleAfter is 12s. Past it the pane reports itself stale and drops the lanes rather than drawing a queue nobody has confirmed — a stale queue drawn as live is the screen somebody decides against.
